arxiv-2002-03396.title: On Some Solutions to Hofstadter’s V V -Recurrence
arxiv-2002-03396.creator: AAAltug Alkan, Nathan Fox, Orhan Ozgur Aybar, Zehra Akdeniz
arxiv-2002-03396.description: Abstract In this study, we explore the properties of certain solutions of Hofstadter’s famous V V -recurrence, defined by the nested recurrence relation V ⁡ ( n ) = V ⁡ ( n − V ⁡ ( n − 1 ) ) + V ⁡ ( n − V ⁡ ( n − 4 ) ) V(n)=V(n-V(n-1))+V(n-V(n-4)) .

arxiv-2104-11976.title: Aerodynamic effects and performance improvements of running in drafting formations Journal: Journal of Biomechanics
arxiv-2104-11976.creator: Lukas Schickhofer, Henry Hanson
arxiv-2104-11976.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lukas Schickhofer, Henry Hanson. Drafting as a process to reduce drag and to benefit from the presence of other competitors is applied in various sports with several recent examples of competitive running in formations.

arxiv-2106-06501.title: Analytical theory for three wave-mixing processes in a slightly deformed cylinder
arxiv-2106-06501.creator: Raksha Singla, W. Luis Mochán
arxiv-2106-06501.description: Abstract The second order optical response of centrosymmetric materials manifests itself mostly at their surface, being strongly suppressed in their bulk. However, the overall surface response is also suppressed in nanoparticles with a centrosymmetric geometry subjected to homogeneous fields. Nevertheless, nanoparticles with a noncentrosymmetric geometry do exhibit second order optical properties.

arxiv-2208-14594.title: One-class Recommendation Systems with the Hinge Pairwise Distance Loss and Orthogonal Representations
arxiv-2208-14594.creator: Ramin Raziperchikolaei, Young-joo Chung
arxiv-2208-14594.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ramin Raziperchikolaei, Young-joo Chung. In one-class recommendation systems, the goal is to learn a model from a small set of interacted users and items and then identify the positively-related user-item pairs among a large number of pairs with unknown interactions. Most previous loss functions rely on dissimilar pairs of users and items, which are selected from the ones with unknown interactions, to obtain better prediction performance.

arxiv-2301-00894.title: Nominal Recursors as Epi-Recursors: Extended Technical Report Thanks: This is an extended version of the paper “Nominal Recursors as Epi-Recursors” published in POPL 2024. It includes an appendix that gives more details about the results and their proofs. CCS: Theory of computation Logic and verific
arxiv-2301-00894.creator: Andrei Popescu
arxiv-2301-00894.description: Abstract . We study nominal recursors from the literature on syntax with bindings and compare them with respect to expressiveness. The term “nominal” refers to the fact that these recursors operate on a syntax representation where the names of bound variables appear explicitly, as in nominal logic.

arxiv-2304-04262.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Knowledge Distillation of Diffusion Models
arxiv-2304-04262.creator: Weijian Luo luoweijian@stu.pku.edu.cn
arxiv-2304-04262.description: Abstract Diffusion Models (DMs), also referred to as score-based diffusion models, utilize neural networks to specify score functions. Unlike most other probabilistic models, DMs directly model the score functions, which makes them more flexible to parametrize and potentially highly expressive for probabilistic modeling. DMs can learn fine-grained knowledge, i.e., marginal score functions, of the underlying distribution.

arxiv-2305-14961.title: Deep Learning for Survival Analysis: A Review
arxiv-2305-14961.creator: Simon Wiegrebe, Philipp Kopper, Raphael Sonabend, Bernd Bischl, Andreas Bender
arxiv-2305-14961.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Simon Wiegrebe, Philipp Kopper, Raphael Sonabend, Bernd Bischl, Andreas Bender. The influx of deep learning (DL) techniques into the field of survival analysis in recent years has led to substantial methodological progress; for instance, learning from unstructured or high-dimensional data such as images, text or omics data. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive systematic review of DL-based methods for time-to-event analysis, characterizing them according to both survival- and DL-related attributes.

arxiv-2311-16436.title: The measurement of masses of OB-type stars from LAMOST DR5 Journal: ApJS
arxiv-2311-16436.creator: Zhenyan Huo, Zhicun Liu, Wenyuan Cui, Chao Liu, Jiaming Liu, Mingxu Sun, Shuai Feng, Linlin Li
arxiv-2311-16436.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhenyan Huo, Zhicun Liu, Wenyuan Cui, Chao Liu, Jiaming Liu, Mingxu Sun, Shuai Feng, Linlin Li. The measurements of masses and luminosities of massive stars play an important role in understanding the formation and evolution of their host galaxies. In this work, we present the measurement of masses and luminosities of 2,946 OB-type stars, including 78 O-type stars and 2,868 B-type stars, based on their stellar parameters (effective temperature, surface gravity, and metallicity) and PARSEC isochrones model.

arxiv-2412-11851.title: A Benchmark and Robustness Study of In-Context-Learning with Large Language Models in Music Entity Detection
arxiv-2412-11851.creator: Simon Hachmeier, Robert Jäschke
arxiv-2412-11851.description: Abstract Detecting music entities such as song titles or artist names is a useful application to help use cases like processing music search queries or analyzing music consumption on the web. Recent approaches incorporate smaller language models (SLMs) like BERT and achieve high results.

arxiv-2506-13613.title: Variational Inference with Mixtures of Isotropic Gaussians
arxiv-2506-13613.creator: Marguerite Petit-Talamon, Marc Lambert, Anna Korba
arxiv-2506-13613.description: Abstract Variational inference (VI) is a popular approach in Bayesian inference, that looks for the best approximation of the posterior distribution within a parametric family, minimizing a loss that is typically the (reverse) Kullback-Leibler (KL) diver- gence. In this paper, we focus on the following parametric family: mixtures of isotropic Gaussians (i.e.

arxiv-2510-08704.title: Loop functions of sunset diagrams in 2+1 space-time dimensions
arxiv-2510-08704.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . In these notes the relativistic n n -body phase-phase is calculated iteratively in 2 + 1 2+1 space-time dimensions for all n n . The obtained result shows a simple power-law behavior α n ​ ( μ − M ) n − 2 / μ \alpha_{n}(\mu-M)^{n-2}/\mu with a dependence only on the total mass M = m 1 + ⋯ + m n M=m_{1}+\dots+m_{n} .

arxiv-2511-20206.title: Exploring the statistical properties of the neutron-deficient 109 In isotope with the Oslo method
arxiv-2511-20206.creator: M. Markova, A. C. Larsen, P. von Neumann-Cosel, E. Litvinova, S. Goriely, L. T. Bell, T. K. Eriksen, A. Görgen, M. Guttormsen, E. F. Matthews, A. J. Nordberg, W. Paulsen, L. G. Pedersen, F. Pogliano, E. Sahin, S. Siem, T. G. Tornyi
arxiv-2511-20206.description: Abstract The nuclear level density (NLD) and the γ \gamma -ray strength function (GSF) of the neutron-deficient 109 In isotope were extracted for the first time with data from the 106 Cd ( α , p ​ γ ) (\alpha,p\gamma) 109 In reaction using a combination of the Oslo and the shape methods.

arxiv-2602-08654.title: Compact linearly uncoupled resonators for efficient spontaneous parametric downconversion via angular phase matching
arxiv-2602-08654.creator: Alessia Stefano, Matteo Piccolini, Marco Liscidini
arxiv-2602-08654.description: Abstract We report an integrated platform for efficient second-order nonlinear interactions based on linearly uncoupled resonators and angular phase matching. The proposed architecture confines phase control to a limited section of the device, maximizing field enhancement and effective nonlinear interaction length while simultaneously reducing the overall footprint.

arxiv-2606-07963.title: Shared Latent Structures Enable Unified Backdoor Detection and Mitigation in LLMs
arxiv-2606-07963.creator: Omar Mahmoud, Aly M. Kassem, Thommen George Karimpanal, Buddhika Laknath Semage, Negar Rostamzadeh, Golnoosh Farnadi, Santu Rana

britannica-1911-spinola-ambrose.title: Spinola, Ambrose (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-spinola-ambrose.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-spinola-ambrose.description: Article 'Spinola, Ambrose' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Spanish general, was born in Genoa in 1569. He was the eldest son of Philip Spinola, marquis of Sesto and Benafro, and his wife Policena, daughter of the prince of Salerno. The family of Spinola was of great antiquity, wealth and power in Genoa.

pmc-10504455.title: The role of radiology in diagnosis of Zinner syndrome in a young man with scrotal pain
pmc-10504455.creator: Ali Zare, Behzad Narouie, Farzad Moloudi, Fatemeh Moosavian, Mohadese Ahmadzade, Hamidreza Rouientan
pmc-10504455.description: Zinner Syndrome is a rare congenital anomaly. It is considered a rare cause of male infertility and can cause a range of clinical manifestations that may lead to significant morbidity. The diagnosis of Zinner Syndrome requires a high index of suspicion, combined with a detailed clinical evaluation and imaging studies.

pmc-10552254.title: Preconditioning of the motor network with repetitive navigated transcranial magnetic stimulation (rnTMS) to improve oncological and functional outcome in brain tumor surgery: a study protocol for a randomized, sham-controlled, triple-blind clinical trial
pmc-10552254.creator: Melina Engelhardt, Ulrike Grittner, Sandro Krieg, Thomas Picht
pmc-10552254.description: BackgroundThe extent of resection of glioma is one of the most important predictors of the survival duration of patients after surgery. The presence of eloquent areas within or near a tumor often limits resection, as resection of these areas would result in functional loss and reduced quality of life.

pmc-10709274.title: Infection with COVID-19 promotes the progression of pancreatic cancer through the PI3K-AKT signaling pathway
pmc-10709274.creator: Xusheng Zhang, Bendong Chen, Kejun Liu, Yongxin Ma, Yimin Liu, Hongcai Zhou, Peng Wei
pmc-10709274.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveTo investigate the effect of COVID-19 infection on pancreatic cancer.MethodsBased on the mRNA-Seq data of COVID-19 patients and pancreatic cancer (PC) patients in the GEO database, we used a support vector machine (SVM), LASSO-Cox regression analysis and random forest tree (RF) to screen the common signature genes of the two diseases and further investigate their effects and functional characteristics on PC, respectively.

pmc-10736386.title: THE TELEPHONE INTERVIEW FOR COGNITIVE STATUS (TICS): LATENT STRUCTURE OF COGNITION IN DOD-ADNI VIETNAM WAR VETERANS
pmc-10736386.creator: Larry Tupler, Igor Akushevich
pmc-10736386.description: The Telephone Interview for Cognitive Status (TICS) is a convenient, user-friendly neuropsychological tool developed to correlate with the MMSE and screen for dementia. Typically, thresholding supports diagnostic inferences despite the arbitrary assignment of individual item contributions to the score. Furthermore, although partially validated with World War II veterans, little subsequent psychometric work with aging military cohorts exists.

pmc-11488130.title: Nanosecond Carrier Lifetime of Hexagonal Ge
pmc-11488130.creator: Victor
pmc-11488130.description: Hexagonal Si1–xGex with suitable alloy composition promises to become a new silicon compatible direct bandgap family of semiconductors. Theoretical calculations, however, predict that the binary end point of this family, the bulk hex-Ge crystal, is only weakly dipole active. This is in contrast to hex-Si1–xGex, where translation symmetry is broken by alloy disorder, permitting efficient light emission.

pmc-11626370.title: Non‐linear association between air pollutants and secondary sensitive skin in acne patients
pmc-11626370.creator: Xiangfeng Chen, Jing Wen, Wenjuan Wu, Ying Tu, Qiuzhi Peng, Sifan Tao, Haoran Yang, Li He
pmc-11626370.description: BackgroundThere is a growing number of patients suffering from sensitive skin secondary to acne, but its prevalence and influencing factors are not yet well‐understood.ObjectiveThe aim of this study is to investigate the nonlinear relationship between air pollutants and secondary sensitive skin in acne patients.

pmc-11682909.title: Alzheimer's disease: a comprehensive review of epidemiology, risk factors, symptoms diagnosis, management, caregiving, advanced treatments and associated challenges
pmc-11682909.creator: Saeid Safiri, Amir Ghaffari Jolfayi, Asra Fazlollahi, Soroush Morsali, Aila Sarkesh, Amin Daei Sorkhabi, Behnam Golabi, Reza Aletaha, Kimia Motlagh Asghari, Sana Hamidi, Seyed Ehsan Mousavi, Sepehr Jamalkhani, Nahid Karamzad, Ali Shamekh, Reza Mohammadinasab, Mark J. M. Sullman, Fikrettin Şahin, Ali
pmc-11682909.description: BackgroundAlzheimer's disease (AD) is a chronic, progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by cognitive decline, memory loss, and impaired reasoning. It is the leading cause of dementia in older adults, marked by the pathological accumulation of amyloid-beta plaques and neurofibrillary tangles. These pathological changes lead to widespread neuronal damage, significantly impacting daily functioning and quality of life.

pmc-12551060.title: Role of Oxygen Saturation Index as a Noninvasive Surrogate Marker of Oxygenation in Intubated Critically Ill Adult Patients: A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-12551060.creator: Abraham Koshy, George Kurian, Jubin Jacob, David Vincent, Shoma V Rao, K Subramani, J Grace Rebekah
pmc-12551060.description: Background and aimThis study aims to compare the oxygenation saturation index (OSI), a noninvasive marker, with commonly used invasive markers of oxygenation [PaO2, PaO2 to FiO2 (P/F) ratio, oxygenation index (OI)] in critically ill patients requiring invasive mechanical ventilatory support after 48 hours of admission in a surgical intensive care unit (ICU).

pmc-12691238.title: Dyslipidemia Assessed in Pediatric Patients: Validation of LDL-C Assessed by Friedewald Formula, Direct Assessment, and Sampson–NIH Formula
pmc-12691238.creator: Joanna Wawer, Agnieszka Chojęta, Jakub Swadźba, Mariola Janiszewska, Michał Chojęta, Genowefa Anna Wawer, Ewelina Grywalska, Anna Milaniuk
pmc-12691238.description: Background: The epidemic increase in obesity, metabolic syndrome, cardiac disease, or hypertension is associated with lipid deregulation. Studies suggest a strong link between elevated levels of plasma cholesterol and the premature formation of atherosclerotic plaques. Primary prevention of early clinical manifestations of atherosclerosis allows slowing or preventing the development of several health problems later in adult life.

pmc-12714511.title: Spinal Subdural Hematoma After Dual Antiplatelet Therapy
pmc-12714511.creator: Nitharsha Prakash, Vinod Kumar Balakrishnan, Sankaran S. Ramesh, Preetam Krishnamurthy, G. Sudhir, Kailash Karthik, Sindhu Reddy Dwarampudi, Harilalith Kovurireddy, Adhiyaa N.S.S., Sharath Shanmugam
pmc-12714511.description: BackgroundNontraumatic spinal subdural hematoma is an extremely rare occurrence. This case highlights the challenging management strategy for this situation.Early Reports SummaryA 77-year-old woman developed nonspecific back pain after percutaneous coronary intervention, with progressive neurological deficits. Imaging demonstrated subdural hematoma in the lumbar spine. She was managed with steroids and withholding of antiplatelet drugs.

pmc-12813753.title: A Novel Electrocardiographic Index to Predict the Severity of Coronary Calcification
pmc-12813753.creator: Serkan Duyuler, Koray Arslan, Raif Can Karabulut, Atik Aksoy, Mustafa Dağlı, Pınar Türker Duyuler
pmc-12813753.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objective:Electrocardiogram (ECG) remains an essential tool in cardiology. Coronary artery calcium (CAC) score, measured via computed tomography, is a well-established predictor of cardiovascular risk. However, its cost and availability limit widespread use. This study introduces a novel ECG-based index, the PARLA(Prediction of Ischemia via Angle of QRS-T and corrected QTLength Assessment)Index, combining the QTc interval and frontal QRS-T (fQRS-T) angle, to assess its association with CAC severity.Methods:This retrospective, cross-sectional study included patients who underwent ECG and coronary computed tomography angiography.

pmc-13075499.title: Legionellosis: Global Epidemiology and Current Perspectives on Diagnosis and Treatment
pmc-13075499.creator: Jianwen Ma, Tingyan Dong, Fei Li, Chunmei He, Biyun Li, Zhenyu Liu
pmc-13075499.description: The genus Legionella, first identified in 1977, comprises environmental Gram-negative intracellular bacteria that cause Legionellosis. Ubiquitous in freshwater and artificial water systems, Legionella species have an unclear global incidence, with reported cases likely significantly underestimated. Travel-associated Legionnaires’ disease (TALD) has increased recently and become a surveillance priority. For diagnosis, culture remains the gold standard but is time-consuming.

pmc-13204369.title: Tunable Particle Separation in a Straight Microchannel via Symmetrical Viscoelastic Sheath Flows
pmc-13204369.creator: Tianyuan Zhou, Qi Cui, Guizhong Tian, Jing Xia, Ping Liu, Yoichiroh Hosokawa, Yaxiaer Yalikun, Pan Wang, Shilun Feng, Tianlong Zhang
pmc-13204369.description: In this study, we present a novel microfluidic platform for tunable size-based particle separation within a straight microchannel using symmetrical viscoelastic sheath flows. The device incorporates two pairs of symmetrical microchannels for sheath fluid injection: the first pair facilitates particle focusing and separation, while the second pair enables dynamic regulation of the separation distance between particle streams.

pmc-13226329.title: Hotspots and Trends in Research on Postpartum Pelvic Floor Dysfunction: A Visualization and Bibliometric Analysis Using CiteSpace
pmc-13226329.creator: Qianqian Zhou, Yiwen Jiang, Qing Cai, Leilei Zhu, Wei Xu
pmc-13226329.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionPelvic floor dysfunction (PFD) is a common condition that affects many women after childbirth. A considerable number of studies have been published on postpartum PFD; however, there is a lack of systematic quantification and comprehensive summary of these studies.

pmc-13312530.title: Spatial associations between neuronal membrane damage and vasculature after repetitive diffuse TBI in pigs
pmc-13312530.creator: Kathryn L. Wofford, Erin M. Purvis Conway, Victor P. Acero, Jerry Gao, Olivia M. Rivellini, Emory Kuo, Constance J. Mietus, Kevin D. Browne, John C. O’Donnell, D. Kacy Cullen
pmc-13312530.description: Closed-head traumatic brain injury (TBI) generally results in diffusely distributed neuropathology. However, factors influencing the micro-scale distribution of this neuropathology remain unknown. Because neurovasculature exhibits different mechanical properties from the surrounding parenchyma, we postulated that these material transitions would increase the likelihood of biophysical damage and resultant neuropathology.

pmc-13339678.title: Beyond Visibility: Social Media, Trust, and Responsibility in Oncology
pmc-13339678.creator: Joud Hajjar, Mark A. Lewis
pmc-13339678.description: Ahmed, Atlal Abusanad, and Gil Morgan address this reality in their review of the benefits and risks of social media in modern healthcare.[1] There is clear value in social media. It can improve access to information, connect patients and caregivers with support, increase awareness of clinical trials, and allow physicians and scientists to communicate beyond traditional academic spaces.
